title: adenocarpus viscosus
intro:
Adenocarpus viscosus, commonly known as the sticky broom, is a plant species found in the Mediterranean region, characterized by its sticky stems and branches.

This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and wounds.

The therapeutic actions of Adenocarpus viscosus include its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which can help to protect against infections and reduce inflammation in the body.

The bioactive constituents of Adenocarpus viscosus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may help to protect against oxidative stress and cell damage.
